name: Timing Assist
description: Holds your click for a few ms until the timing is safe, then lets it through. Works in every gamemode.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the timing assist on or off.

max-delay.name: Max Delay (ms)
max-delay.description: The longest a click can be held back while waiting for a safe tick. Higher saves more clicks but can feel floaty. 1 tick is about 4ms.

hold-max-delay.name: Wave & Ship Max Delay (ms)
hold-max-delay.description: Max delay for wave and ship. Kept small because a delayed press in wave feels like the game ignored you.

lookahead.name: Lookahead (ms)
lookahead.description: How far ahead it checks whether a click would kill you in ship, wave, UFO, swing and spider. Cube, ball and robot always follow the jump until you land (up to 1.5s).

simulate-orbs.name: Orbs & Pads
simulate-orbs.description: Lets the check see through orbs and pads using the game's own orb physics, so it can line up clicks on orbs too. Custom orbs, teleport orbs and portals still stop the check. Turn off if something acts weird near orbs.

input-lead.name: Input Lead (ms)
input-lead.description: Delays every click by this tiny amount so the mod can also move clicks earlier, not just later. Set to 0 to turn it off.

keep-hold.name: Keep Hold Length
keep-hold.description: If a press gets delayed, your release gets delayed by the same amount, so you still hold for as long as you meant to.

release-assist.name: Release Assist
release-assist.description: In ship, wave and robot, also checks your release and nudges it to the closest safe tick.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: If the mod moved any of your inputs during an attempt, that attempt won't save progress. Attempts where it never stepped in still count.

indicator.name: Show Adjustments
indicator.description: Shows a small label in the bottom left whenever an input gets moved. Takes effect next time you enter a level.

debug-overlay.name: Debug Overlay
debug-overlay.description: Draws where you'd die if you click or don't click right now (green = click/hold, blue = don't click/release). When the mod moves an input it briefly shows your timing in orange and its pick in yellow, and it labels every decision in the corner.

smart-predict.name: Smart Predict
smart-predict.description: Fixes clicks that came a little too late. If clicking now would kill you but clicking a moment ago wouldn't have, it replays those few ticks with the click in the right spot. Your icon slides over to the fixed path instead of snapping, and fixes that would move you too far are skipped.

smart-window.name: Smart Predict Window (ms)
smart-window.description: How late a click can be and still get fixed. Bigger windows save more clicks but the snap gets more noticeable.

wave-adjust.name: Wave Adjust
wave-adjust.description: Super experimental. If you let go in wave at a bad time, it keeps holding for you until letting go is safe, then lets go. Clicking again while it's holding just keeps you holding.

adjust-max.name: Wave Adjust Max Hold (ms)
adjust-max.description: The longest Wave Adjust will keep holding before it lets go anyway.
